kNN 用标准化后的多特征距离寻找已标注岩性近邻，以投票给像元分类。: kNN finds labelled lithology neighbours in standardized feature space and classifies a pixel by voting.
岩性在单一颜色上可能重叠，多特征与相似样本能够补充判断。与单特征阈值比较，才能检: Lithologies overlap in one colour. Multiple features and similar labelled samples may help, tested against a single-feature rule.
训练图提供独立标注，训练均值和标准差用于变换测试像元；最近邻距离、各类票数与误差: An independent training image provides labels and scaling. Distances, class votes and errors expose the decision chain.
观测与候选滑动对照定位改变的位置。: The observation/candidate slider locates changed regions.
像元检查列出实际邻居与投票依据。: Pixel inspection exposes actual neighbours and votes.
独立误差图检验哪些岩性被混淆。: Held-out error maps identify confused lithologies.
K-means 学习多个背景中心，以样点到最近中心的标准化距离作为异常分数。: K-means learns several background centres; standardized distance to the nearest centre is the anomaly score.
单指标高值可能来自背景或污染，多指标背景建模能发现联合偏离。但异常只代表与参考不: One high measurement can reflect background or contamination. Joint deviations from learned background are candidates, not proof of hydrocarbons.
仅用已知背景参考样本拟合标准化和中心，测试点不参与拟合；中心迭代、距离阈值与复查: Known background references fit scaling and centres without test data. Iterations, distance thresholds and review maps expose the process.
类中心迭代可视化模型如何学习背景。: Centre iterations show how background is learned.
阈值与错误图揭示误报和漏报的取舍。: Thresholds and errors expose the false-alarm/miss trade-off.
最近类中心分类学习标注颜色的中心，再进行同类小区域合并，输出图件类别和边界线段。: Nearest-centroid classification learns labelled colour centres, followed by small-region merging and boundary extraction.
旧图扫描会产生噪声与碎片。学习图例样本比硬编码颜色更能适配当前图件，区域后处理则: Scans produce noise and fragments. Learned legend colours adapt classification, while region cleanup trades fragmentation against small-feature loss.
参考标注拟合各类特征中心，测试像元按最近中心分类；比较合并前后标签，使用测试真值: Labelled references fit class centres. Test pixels choose the nearest centre, and before/after labels and held-out errors assess cleanup.
图例样本与原始观测解释学习输入。: Legend samples and observations explain the learning input.
合并前后与边界线段显示后处理代价。: Before/after regions and boundary segments reveal cleanup costs.
误差图防止只凭图面整洁判断模型成功。: Error maps prevent visual neatness from being mistaken for accuracy.
逻辑回归组合观测灰度中提取的暗度、暗脊与方向一致性，输出构造线候选分数。: Logistic regression combines darkness, ridge and orientation features extracted from observed grey pixels.
道路和阴影也可能呈现线性暗纹，单一亮度阈值容易误判。多个可解释特征帮助区分局部形: Roads and shadows also form dark lines. Multiple shape features can improve discrimination without confirming geological origin.
特征只读取观测像素，独立参考标签训练交叉熵权重；候选阈值和小连通域过滤产生结果，: Features read observed pixels only. Independent labels fit cross-entropy weights, followed by thresholding, component filtering and baseline evaluation.
观测、特征与候选对应同一个像元。: Observation, features and candidates refer to the same pixel.
真实损失曲线展示训练而非预制进度。: The actual loss curve reports training rather than canned progress.
阴影失败预设暴露模型的地质解释边界。: Shadow failure presets expose interpretation limits.
逻辑回归识别裂缝候选，骨架化与局部方向统计把像元分类转为可读的方向分布。: Logistic regression identifies candidates; skeletonization and local orientation statistics produce a readable direction distribution.
自动候选减少逐像元描绘，但方向统计还依赖候选质量。骨架和玫瑰图必须与原图联动，避: Candidates reduce manual tracing, but orientation statistics depend on their quality. Linked skeletons and rose plots expose texture and intersection errors.
观测灰度特征进入独立训练的分类器，经阈值和连通域过滤后提取骨架；点击方向扇区回看: Observed-image features enter an independently trained classifier, followed by filtering and skeletonization. Orientation bins link back to supporting pixels.
候选与骨架解释方向图的数据来源。: Candidates and skeletons explain the source of orientation counts.
玫瑰图扇区高亮支持该方向的局部骨架。: Rose sectors highlight supporting local skeleton pixels.
真值误差图揭示漏检、误检和交叉点影响。: Ground-truth errors reveal misses, false positives and intersection effects.
